properties.displayName: Audit Azure Hybrid Benefit for Azure SQL Managed Instance
properties.description: Audits in-scope Azure SQL Managed Instances that are not in an instance pool and do not use Azure Hybrid Benefit (licenseType BasePrice). Enabled=true checks all matching in-scope resources; false skips. Confirm licensing eligibility independently.

metadata.description: Audit (default) reports non-compliant resources. Deny can be selected later to block non-compliant changes; Disabled turns the policy off.

True checks every matching resource within the assignment scope; false skips the check. Use assignment exclusions or exemptions for exceptions. Enable only after independently confirming licensing eligibility throughout the scope. Exclude centrally managed licensing scopes and other ineligible resources; entitlement is not inferred. Select true or false; defaults to true.
